decisions.decision: Preserve the existing .atgv workspace and add src/extension, src/library and src/error-logs beneath it. Source folders contain verified Git checkouts; all ATGV errors must be collected centrally in src/error-logs.
When a verified GitHub issue or PR matches an error log, delete only that log. Retain unverified errors and archive successfully submitted PR evidence.

Use .atgv/src/error-logs as the unified sanitized error queue for startup, BA, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Developer, Solution Architect, AI and runtime errors; preserve existing specialty diagnostics and archive submitted PR evidence.
